name: Artcellism: Artcell 20th Anniversary Open-Air Concert

notes: Marked Artcell's 20th anniversary; thousands of fans gathered at the ICCB Expo Zone for the open-air celebration, reflecting the band's capacity to draw large-scale audiences beyond typical club/campus shows. Exact month within late 2019 requires further verification.
